simple.prompt: At 3:00 p.m. yesterday, our team ___ the quarterly financial audit.
simple.explanation: Pada jam spesifik di masa lampau ('At 3:00 p.m. yesterday'), aktivitas sedang berlangsung. Subjek tunggal 'our team' berpasangan dengan 'was conducting'.
hints: Aktivitas sedang berlangsung pada jam tertentu di masa lalu.

simple.prompt: The developers ___ bugs in the codebase all night long.
simple.explanation: Subjek jamak 'The developers' berpasangan dengan 'were' + verb-ing: 'were fixing'.

simple.targetSentence: She was writing the proposal yesterday afternoon.
simple.explanation: Subject (She) + was + Verb-ing (writing) + Object (the proposal) + Time (yesterday afternoon).

simple.prompt: I ___ for the bus when the heavy rain suddenly started.
simple.explanation: Aksi latar belakang yang sedang berlangsung lebih panjang (background continuous action) memakai Past Continuous: 'was waiting'.
hints: Aksi sedang berlangsung sebelum dipotong oleh hujan.

simple.targetSentence: They were not working at six o'clock.
simple.explanation: Subject (They) + were + not + Verb-ing (working) + at six o'clock.

simple.prompt: What ___ you doing when the fire alarm sounded in the building?
simple.explanation: Pertanyaan Past Continuous untuk subjek 'you': 'What were you doing...?'

simple.targetSentence: Was he reviewing the contract yesterday?
simple.explanation: To be (Was) + Subject (he) + Verb-ing (reviewing) + the contract + yesterday?

simple.prompt: At eight o'clock last night, Maya ___ dinner for her guests.
simple.explanation: Tindakan yang sedang berlangsung pada titik waktu lampau spesifik ('At eight o'clock last night') untuk subjek 'Maya' memakai 'was cooking'.
hints: Ada jam spesifik di masa lampau: aksi sedang berjalan.

simple.prompt: While the students ___ quietly, the fire alarm rang.
simple.explanation: Subjek jamak 'the students' memakai 'were + V-ing' untuk aktivitas latar yang sedang berlangsung.

simple.prompt: I ___ sleeping when you knocked on the front door; I was already awake.
simple.explanation: Bentuk negatif Past Continuous untuk 'I' + 'sleeping' adalah 'wasn't'.

simple.prompt: What ___ your brother doing when the heavy rain started?
simple.explanation: Pertanyaan Past Continuous dengan V-ing 'doing' dan subjek tunggal 'your brother' memakai 'was'.
hints: Ada V-ing 'doing', jadi pakai to be lampau 'was'.

simple.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan tentang kejadian kemarin sore.
dialogue: Nisa
Why didn't you pick up my call at four yesterday?
Bagas
Sorry! I ___ to a loud online seminar at that moment.
simple.explanation: 'At that moment' di masa lalu menandakan aktivitas yang sedang berlangsung pada jam 4 kemarin: 'was listening'.

simple.prompt: We were ___ the exhibition hall when the photographer arrived.
simple.explanation: Setelah 'were' pada Past Continuous aktif, gunakan present participle '-ing' ('decorating').

simple.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan pasangan to be pada kalimat Past Continuous berikut.
simple.draft: The warehouse staff was loading the delivery truck when it began to drizzle.
options: The warehouse staff were loading the delivery truck when it began to drizzle.
The warehouse staff is loading the delivery truck when it began to drizzle.
The warehouse staff were load the delivery truck when it began to drizzle.
simple.explanation: Dalam konteks jamak yang merujuk pada para staf ('were loading'), dan konsisten waktu lampau ('when it began'), hindari present 'is' atau V1 tanpa -ing.
hints: 'Staff' di sini mengacu pada beberapa pekerja (atau pastikan verb tetap V-ing lampau).
Hanya opsi pertama yang konsisten lampau & V-ing.

simple.prompt: Were the engineers testing the backup generator? — Yes, they ___.
simple.explanation: Pertanyaan dimulai 'Were', sehingga jawaban singkat untuk 'they' adalah 'Yes, they were.'

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat Past Continuous yang disela aksi singkat.
simple.targetSentence: I was drafting an email when my laptop restarted.
simple.explanation: 'Was drafting' (aksi panjang berlangsung) disela oleh 'restarted' (aksi singkat Past Simple).
hints: Awali dengan 'I was drafting an email'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat tanya Past Continuous tentang aktivitas siang hari.
simple.targetSentence: Were you waiting at the north gate around noon?
simple.explanation: Pertanyaan Past Continuous membalik 'Were' sebelum subjek 'you' + V-ing.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog alibi penyelidikan dengan Past Continuous.
dialogue: Detective
What were you doing at 9:00 p.m. last night?
Witness
I ___ dinner with my colleagues at a downtown restaurant.
intermediate.explanation: Menjawab aktivitas yang sedang berlangsung pada titik waktu lampau spesifik menggunakan Past Continuous: 'I was having dinner'.

intermediate.prompt: While the analysts were preparing the charts, the manager ___ the summary report.
intermediate.explanation: Dua aksi berdurasi yang berlangsung bersamaan secara simultan di masa lampau (parallel continuous actions) keduanya memakai Past Continuous: 'While A was preparing... B was drafting'.
hints: Dua aktivitas berjalan bersamaan secara simultan.

intermediate.prompt: The internet connection went offline while we ___ the software update.
intermediate.explanation: Klausa setelah 'while' yang menunjukkan proses yang sedang berjalan memakai Past Continuous: 'while we were downloading'.
hints: Setelah kata hubung 'while' untuk proses yang berlangsung.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat yang menggabungkan Past Continuous dan Past Simple dengan 'when'.
intermediate.targetSentence: I was walking home when I met Sarah.
intermediate.explanation: Aksi latar belakang (I was walking home) dipotong oleh aksi singkat (when I met Sarah).
hints: Aksi latar belakang: 'I was walking home'.
Aksi interupsi singkat diawali 'when I met Sarah'.

intermediate.prompt: Throughout the entire winter, the temperature ___ steadily colder every week.
intermediate.explanation: Menyatakan proses perubahan bertahap di masa lampau (gradual past change): 'was getting steadily colder'.
hints: Perubahan yang terjadi bertahap di masa lalu.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat dua aktivitas simultan yang dihubungkan dengan 'while'.
intermediate.targetSentence: She was coding while he was designing.
intermediate.explanation: Dua aktivitas simultan: She was coding + while + he was designing.
hints: Aktivitas kedua setelah while: 'he was designing'.

intermediate.prompt: Pilih bentuk interupsi aksi yang tepat dalam dialog.
dialogue: Manager
Why didn't you answer my phone call at two o'clock?
Staff
I apologize; I ___ a client presentation at that exact moment.
intermediate.explanation: Alasan tidak menjawab telepon adalah karena sedang berada di tengah-tengah aktivitas presentasi: 'was delivering'.

intermediate.prompt: While the presenter ___ the slides, the technician ___ the sound mixer.
intermediate.explanation: Dua aktivitas yang berlangsung bersamaan secara paralel di masa lampau dihubungkan 'while' dan keduanya memakai Past Continuous.
hints: Kedua aksi berjalan beriringan pada waktu yang sama.
Gunakan was/were + V-ing di kedua sisi.

intermediate.prompt: Just as we ___ the theater, someone called out my name.
intermediate.explanation: Konjungsi 'Just as' sangat sering berpasangan dengan Past Continuous untuk aksi yang tengah berlangsung tepat ketika aksi lain terjadi.
hints: Perhatikan frasa waktu tepat saat kejadian ('Just as').
Aksi keluar baru saja berlangsung saat dipanggil.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog di ruang rapat mengenai alasan keterlambatan.
dialogue: Lead
Did the server crash while you ___ the client database?
Dev
Yes! I had to restore everything from the morning snapshot.
intermediate.explanation: Setelah 'while' dalam konteks lampau, aksi panjang yang terinterupsi memakai Past Continuous ('were backing up').
hints: Proses backup sedang berlangsung saat server jatuh.

intermediate.prompt: Between 2020 and 2022, remote work tools ___ rapidly across small businesses.
intermediate.explanation: Tren perubahan bertahap selama rentang waktu lampau dapat digambarkan dengan Past Continuous ('were expanding').
hints: Menggambarkan perkembangan yang tengah berlangsung di periode lampau.

intermediate.prompt: I dropped my badge while I ___ through the revolving lobby door.
intermediate.explanation: Aktivitas lebih lama yang melatarbelakangi peristiwa jatuh ('dropped') memakai 'was walking'.
hints: Mana aksi yang berdurasi lebih lama?

intermediate.prompt: Sunting kesalahan penggunaan stative verb dalam bentuk Past Continuous berikut.
intermediate.draft: Last year, Roni was owning two small coffee kiosks near the university.
options: Last year, Roni owned two small coffee kiosks near the university.
Last year, Roni were owning two small coffee kiosks near the university.
Last year, Roni owns two small coffee kiosks near the university.
intermediate.explanation: 'Own' adalah stative verb kepemilikan sehingga tidak lazim memakai bentuk continuous ('was owning'); gunakan Past Simple 'owned'.
hints: Kata kerja kepemilikan ('own') termasuk stative verb.

intermediate.prompt: The lights flickered twice while the orchestra ___ the final movement.
intermediate.explanation: Ketika orkestra sebagai satu grup utuh sedang tampil dan lampu berkedip, 'was performing' menunjukkan aksi berlanjut.
hints: Subjek tunggal kolektif 'the orchestra' memakai 'was performing'.

intermediate.prompt: Earlier this morning, I ___ planning to take the ferry, but the waves looked too rough.
intermediate.explanation: Past Continuous dengan verb niat ('was planning', 'was thinking') menyatakan rencana awal di masa lampau yang berubah.
hints: Rencana lampau yang urung memakai 'was planning'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat dua aktivitas lampau yang berjalan sejajar.
intermediate.targetSentence: While Anita was sketching the logo, Farhan was coding the landing page.
intermediate.explanation: 'While' menghubungkan dua aksi berdurasi yang terjadi pada saat bersamaan.
hints: Mulai dengan 'While Anita was sketching the logo,'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat pembuka cerita dengan latar suasana (scene setting).
intermediate.targetSentence: Soft rain was falling as the night train entered the valley.
intermediate.explanation: Past Continuous ('was falling') menciptakan suasana latar belakang cerita lampau.
hints: Tambahkan klausa 'as the night train entered the valley'.

complex.prompt: Koreksi kekeliruan penggunaan stative verb dalam bentuk Past Continuous.
complex.draft: When the merger occurred, he was knowing the true financial situation of the firm.
options: When the merger occurred, he knew the true financial situation of the firm.
When the merger occurred, he had been knowing the true financial situation of the firm.
When the merger occurred, he was known the true financial situation of the firm.
complex.explanation: Kata kerja stative 'know' (mengetahui) tidak boleh berbentuk continuous (-ing). Gunakan Past Simple: 'he knew'.
hints: 'Know' adalah stative verb yang tidak boleh memakai -ing.

complex.prompt: We ___ going to launch the beta test in March, but technical complications forced a postponement.
complex.explanation: 'Was/were going to' digunakan untuk menyatakan rencana masa lalu yang tidak jadi terlaksana (unfulfilled past intention): 'We were going to launch... but...'.
hints: Rencana masa lalu yang batal atau berubah.

complex.prompt: Polite inquiry: 'I ___ wondering if you might have ten minutes to discuss the contract terms?'
complex.explanation: Past Continuous sering digunakan dalam permohonan santun (polite request/tentative framing): 'I was wondering if...' bernada jauh lebih sopan dan tidak menuntut dibanding 'I am wondering'.
hints: Gaya bahasa formal dan santun (tentative framing).

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat sopan dengan formula 'I was hoping'.
complex.targetSentence: I was hoping you could help me.
complex.explanation: Pola permohonan santun: I was hoping + you could help me.
hints: Mulai dengan formula santun 'I was hoping'.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kerancuan penggunaan 'when' vs 'while' pada durasi latar belakang.
complex.draft: She broke her ankle while she played volleyball on Saturday.
options: She broke her ankle while she was playing volleyball on Saturday.
She was breaking her ankle while she played volleyball on Saturday.
She broke her ankle when she was played volleyball on Saturday.
complex.explanation: Aktivitas bermain voli adalah proses latar belakang yang sedang berlangsung saat pergelangan kakinya patah: 'while she was playing volleyball'.
hints: Aktivitas bermain voli sedang berlangsung saat cedera terjadi.

complex.prompt: At university, my roommate ___ leaving his damp towels on the floor, which irritated everyone.
complex.explanation: Pola 'was/were constantly/always + verb-ing' digunakan untuk mendeskripsikan kebiasaan menyebalkan di masa lalu yang membuat orang lain jengkel.
hints: Kekesalan terhadap kebiasaan buruk masa lalu.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi dialog deskripsi latar belakang dalam narasi sastra/laporan.
dialogue: Narrator
The scene was chaotic when the rescue boat arrived.
Survivor
The fierce wind ___ and massive waves were crashing against the hull.
complex.explanation: Deskripsi latar suasana narasi lampau (setting the scene) memakai Past Continuous: 'The fierce wind was howling and massive waves were crashing'.
hints: Membangun suasana latar narasi (setting the scene).

complex.prompt: Excuse me, I ___ if I could borrow your calibration tool for ten minutes.
complex.explanation: Untuk membuat permintaan terdengar sangat halus dan tidak memaksa di kantor/akademik, penutur asli sering memakai Past Continuous tentatif: 'I was wondering if...'.
hints: Fungsi pragmatis Past Continuous untuk kesopanan ekstrem.
Pola baku: 'I was wondering if I could...'.

complex.prompt: My former roommate ___ always leaving wet towels on the wooden desk, which drove me crazy.
complex.explanation: Pola 'was/were + always + V-ing' di masa lalu mengungkapkan kejengkelan terhadap kebiasaan berulang seseorang yang mengganggu.
hints: Past Continuous + 'always' menyatakan kritik/kejengkelan masa lalu.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan nuansa kata kerja persepsi/emosi pada kalimat narasi formal berikut.
complex.draft: Throughout the intense debate, the chairperson was seeming calm and impartial.
options: Throughout the intense debate, the chairperson seemed calm and impartial.
Throughout the intense debate, the chairperson were seeming calm and impartial.
Throughout the intense debate, the chairperson is seeming calm and impartial.
complex.explanation: 'Seem' adalah stative linking verb yang tidak dapat dipakai dalam bentuk continuous ('was seeming'); gunakan Past Simple 'seemed'.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan negosiasi sopan menggunakan bentuk tentatif Past Continuous.
dialogue: Consultant
Hi, Director Lee. ___ whether your team had a chance to review our revised fee table.
Director
Yes, let's walk through it right now.
complex.explanation: 'I was hoping to check whether...' menggunakan Past Continuous untuk mengekspresikan permintaan secara diplomatis dan tidak mendesak.
hints: Ungkapan sopan bisnis memakai Past Continuous ('was hoping').
Pastikan bentuk aktif 'was hoping', bukan pasif.

complex.prompt: The evening crowds ___ thicker by the minute as the festival parade drew closer.
complex.explanation: Di sini 'grow' bermakna perubahan dinamis yang terus meningkat ('by the minute'), sehingga Past Continuous 'were growing' menangkap perkembangan bertahap.
hints: Frasa 'by the minute' menandakan proses perubahan progresif.

complex.prompt: She ___ thinking of accepting the Oslo fellowship until she received the promotion offer here.
complex.explanation: Pilihan paling tepat dan gramatikal: 'She was thinking of accepting...' menggambarkan niat/rencana tentatif di masa lampau sebelum berubah pikiran.
hints: Pilih satu auxiliary lampau yang tepat untuk niat sementara.

complex.prompt: Sunting kesalahan kalimat yang mencampur Past Continuous untuk dua kejadian berurutan cepat (bukan paralel).
complex.draft: When the doorbell was ringing, I was standing up immediately and was opening it.
options: When the doorbell rang, I stood up immediately and opened it.
When the doorbell was ringing, I stood up immediately and opened it.
When the doorbell rang, I was standing up immediately and was opening it.
complex.explanation: Dering bel instan diikuti reaksi berurutan cepat ('stood up... opened') semuanya merupakan aksi singkat selesai (Past Simple), bukan aktivitas panjang paralel.
hints: Tiga peristiwa ini terjadi berturut-turut dengan cepat.
Gunakan Past Simple untuk aksi singkat yang berurutan.

complex.prompt: Outside the courthouse, journalists ___ for statements while inside, the jury ___ on the final verdict.
complex.explanation: Dua adegan latar yang sama-sama berlangsung lama secara bersamaan di masa lampau memakai Past Continuous di kedua klausa.
hints: Konteksnya dua aktivitas paralel yang sedang berjalan.
Kesesuaian subjek: 'journalists were...' dan 'the jury was...'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat sopan bernuansa Past Continuous tentatif.
complex.targetSentence: We were wondering if we could reschedule tomorrow's briefing.
complex.explanation: 'We were wondering if we could...' adalah pembuka permintaan penjadwalan ulang yang sangat sopan.
hints: Lengkapi klausa permintaan 'we could reschedule tomorrow's briefing'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat kritik kebiasaan lampau dengan 'constantly'.
complex.targetSentence: The legacy server was constantly crashing during peak hours.
complex.explanation: Subject + was + constantly + V-ing menekankan kejengkelan atas masalah berulang di masa lalu.
